name: Saner.ai
summary: Notes and task assistant designed for people with ADHD.
description: Saner.ai brings notes, tasks, email and calendar into one space, with an AI assistant that helps plan your day, find information and turn ideas into actions. It's aimed at people who struggle to stay organized.
summary_fr: Assistant de notes et de tâches pensé pour les profils TDAH.
description_fr: Saner.ai réunit notes, tâches, emails et agenda dans un même espace, et un assistant IA aide à planifier la journée, retrouver une information et transformer des idées en actions. Il vise les personnes qui ont du mal à s'organiser.
features: Notes and tasks assistant designed for ADHD workflows.
